photos.c: Above: Belgrave's 1996 National YA Captain, Hammer Thrower Peter Waterman, moves up into the Under 20's this year - but had a final fling in the younger age group by taking the lion's share of the trophies at the Youth in Action Presentation Evening. Peter's tally at the end of the season was a staggering 23 Club Records!
